caption: The drawing depicts a ceramic jug with a decorative bird perched on top of its lid. The jug is predominantly beige or tan with blue painted detailing. The painted decorations include floral motifs and leafy patterns wrapping around the body of the jug. Near the upper portion of the jug, the name "Jamison" is written in a blue cursive script. The jug features braided handles on each side that extend partially onto the lid. The bird atop the lid is stylized, with a blue body and darker blue spots or markings along its wings and body. The background of the image is a plain, light beige or cream color. The artist's signature, “FRANCES LICHTEN,” appears in the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Pa. German Money Bank
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
